protocol.scope: Current C versus only GDN1 input-supported K finite normalization. Original frozen NI0/MH2 inputs, targets, gold and scorer;4DT84score. No FT/generation or native model/FA/FLA changes.
protocol.hypothesis: Actual K finite norm conditional errors improve in the saved local scout. Off-chord input tangent preserves the endpoint chord while reducing early/mid signed and absolute token-head errors. Mid negative error grows, and adjacent propagation/ordering can reverse the improvement, so actual complete original metrics are required.
protocol.method: Same full finite propagation as C; only key_norm_by_layer={1: frozen helper} in candidate. Q normalization, all other GDN/FA, layer0 symmetric normgate and full FLA endpoint average retain C. No final-score transform or mask-specific coefficient.
protocol.actual_cost: Both methods8finiteFA/24phases,25finiteFLA/50nativeadjoints,8publicLSE,32native decoder replays per DT. One K finite callback replaces existing L2 finite operations at GDN1. Same O(BTHD) cost, no extra model/GEMM/path endpoints or T-squared matrices. Actual speed unproven; pilot single timings are not hot/batch evidence.
protocol.coverage: Two previously used developer cases only, no heldout or true batch claim.
protocol.decision: Finish both frozen original curves unless source/numerical/timeout failure. Review own needle/RISE/MAS and both actual mask-family errors. No automatic expansion, continuous weight tuning or promotion from a local sum.
